title: The Fall of Satan
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: The fall of Satan refers to his rebellion against God and descent from created servant to adversary. Scripture does not give every detail, but it teaches enough to warn against pride and rebellion.
summary: The fall of Satan refers to his rebellion against God and descent from created servant to adversary. Scripture does not give every detail, but it teaches enough to warn against pride and rebellion.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the obedient Son who conquers the proud rebel. Where Satan exalts himself against God, Christ humbles Himself, obeys the Father, and triumphs through the cross and resurrection.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Scripture teaches that some angels sinned and did not keep their proper place. Satan stands at the head of rebellion against God, becoming the adversary, deceiver, tempter, and accuser.

The Bible does not satisfy every curiosity about Satan’s fall. It gives enough truth to warn believers against pride, rebellion, deception, and the desire to rise against God’s authority.

Satan’s fall shows that evil is rebellion against the good God. God is not the author of evil, and Satan is not a second sovereign. He is a fallen creature who opposed the Lord.

Christ is the answer to satanic rebellion. The Son of God appeared to destroy the works of the devil, and His victory assures believers that rebellion will not have the final word.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
This doctrine matters because pride is spiritually deadly. Satan’s fall warns that rebellion against God is never freedom; it is ruin.

It also keeps believers from speculation. The purpose of knowing Satan fell is not to feed curiosity, but to strengthen humility, watchfulness, and confidence in Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Reject pride and submit yourself to God. Do not become fascinated with hidden details Scripture does not give. Receive the warning seriously, resist rebellion in your own heart, and worship Christ, whose humility and obedience overcome the pride of the enemy.
